description: This file defines a 'Card' class used for UI components in an Android application, including nested classes for actions and progress indicators. It manages visual states, actions, progress types, and view initialization via a builder pattern.

classes.name: Card
classes.description: Represents a UI card component with title, description, actions, progress indicator, and visual states, constructed via Builder pattern.

classes.name: Card.CardAction
classes.description: Represents an action button on the card with label, ID, type, and view reference.

classes.name: Card.CardProgress
classes.description: Describes progress indicator details such as type, label, current progress, and max value.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the unique tag of the card.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns the View object representing the card.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description text of the card.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title text of the card.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current UI state of the card.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the UI state of the card, updating overlay and animations accordingly.

methods.name: setProgressType
methods.description: Sets the type of progress indicator for the card.

methods.name: getProgressType
methods.description: Returns the current progress indicator type.

methods.name: setProgress
methods.description: Sets the current progress value.

methods.name: setMaxProgress
methods.description: Sets the maximum progress value.

methods.name: setProgressLabel
methods.description: Sets the label text for the progress indicator.

methods.name: setProgressVisibility
methods.description: Shows or hides the progress section.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Adds an action button to the card.

methods.name: setActionVisibility
methods.description: Shows or hides a specific action button.

methods.name: setActionAreaVisibility
methods.description: Animates the visibility of the action area.

methods.name: createShallowClone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the card for state preservation.

methods.name: prepareForConfigurationChange
methods.description: Nullifies view references for configuration changes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the card's view hierarchy and initializes views.

methods.name: cloneFromCard
methods.description: Copies data from an existing card into the builder.

methods.name: initializeActionViews
methods.description: Inflates and sets up action buttons.

methods.name: initializeProgressView
methods.description: Inflates and sets up the progress view.
